probes.check: am_probe_mimalloc_allocation(): blocks the facade serves, plain, zeroed, reallocated and aligned, were served by mimalloc (a probe-build count in the binding) and are in its heap (mi_is_in_heap_region).

seeded_violation.description: Serve every request from the system allocator instead of mimalloc.

not_applicable.reason: mimalloc has no allocator hooks: it is the allocator behind the facade, and serves only the blocks the facade asks for.

adaptation_notes: mimalloc fills the allocator slot: the allocation facade's am_allocator_slot_allocate, am_allocator_slot_reallocate and am_allocator_slot_release call mi_malloc_aligned, mi_realloc and mi_free, so every library's hooks, unchanged, now reach mimalloc.
mi_free frees aligned and unaligned blocks alike, so the facade's aligned and plain release share one path.
